details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Unchanged: clean satin, seams every second window. No linen weave.
F/J short bowl and LED pill. Unchanged and right (s01, ra_jWin).
PY/Y full-height tub and raised bezel. Unchanged. The tub-floor light card remains (245 vs 220).
Shades. The electric blackout and sheer and the manual PY/Y shades are unchanged. The soft corduroy pleat matches room38 at distance; close-up contrast is still about half of room24's.
Dado, grilles and placards. The louvres are a touch darker in lit views (s07 46.5 -> 41.0), which closes part of the light-field gap. The pitch is still fine.
Floors (Y navy carpet, door-area grey vinyl). Unchanged. The hue is right and the vinyl speckle is low.

Type A door lining and viewing window. The window is taller and rises above the handle housing. The shade is now a distinct panel with a visible finger slot over a glowing pane. It is still ~15-20% short of the photo, there is no gap to the housing, and the cream renders neutral [lighting].
